name: Umami
pitch: A simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.
description_md:
Umami provides privacy-friendly website analytics with an approachable dashboard and no cross-site tracking. Use it to understand page views, referrers, devices, and campaigns without adding an advertising network to your site.

This recipe builds the exact pinned upstream commit as a Next.js standalone service. SproutOS provisions managed PostgreSQL, generates a private 32-byte APP_SECRET, and runs the reviewed Prisma migration artifact before a new application version receives traffic. Secret values are injected at runtime and are never committed to the generated repository.

The generated repository keeps the upstream source and SproutOS deployment workflow in the open, so you can inspect the application, follow upstream changes, and redeploy through GitHub Actions.

blocked_reasons: The pinned Umami recipe has not completed a recorded production end-to-end pass covering its controlled migration, first publication, serving health, and a second deployment with persisted data.
